objects.description: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) has established persistence via the Registry key HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run and a shortcut within the startup folder.(Citation: DHS/CISA Ransomware Targeting Healthcare October 2020)(Citation: FireEye KEGTAP SINGLEMALT October 2020)
objects.description_fa: [Wizard Spider](https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0102) پایداری را از طریق کلید رجیستری HKCU\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\Windows\CurrentVersion\Run و یک میانبر در پوشه راه‌اندازی ایجاد کرده است.(Citation: DHS/CISA Ransomware Targeting Healthcare October 2020)[[[CTI_PRESERVE_2]] (Citation: FireEye KEGTAP SINGLEMALT October 2020)
